topic: transport a cello on an airplane
core_question: How do I safely transport my cello when flying? (secondary: How do I get sticky label residue off a glass jar?)
answer_summary: Protect the cello in a hard-shell flight case, and either purchase an additional airline seat to carry it in the cabin or check it as fragile/oversized baggage per the airline's instrument policy.; after the topic shift: Apply Goo Gone or a coating of vegetable/cooking oil to the residue, let it soak in, then rub it off.
